summary: Chart gains onSelect and xScale="time". onSelect fires on Enter or Space on the focused point (with its series key) and on a click on a category (series null when the band holds several); the plot takes cursor-pointer only when it is set, and the chart keeps and draws no selected state because no sheet draws one. xScale="time" places line and area points at their Dates (ascending, parsed by the caller), with ticks on whole UTC years, months or days from new lib/viz helpers (timeTicks, timePositions, tickDateFormat, pointDateFormat); the table, tooltip and announcement print each point's own date. BarChart refuses the time axis in its type; Chart throws on a non-Date, unsorted rows or bars on a time axis.
